The '''Matori Matrix''' (Japanese: '''マトリマトリックス''' ''Matori Matrix'') is a group of recurring characters who appeared in {{aniseries|PTS}}. They are a special [[Team Rocket]] elite unit under the leadership of [[Matori]], {{an|Giovanni}}'s personal secretary.

==History==
==={{aniseries|SM}}===
The Matori Matrix debuted in ''[[SM087|Filling the Light with Darkness!]]'', where they approached [[Alola]] by helicopter. They were contacted by Giovanni, who asked for a briefing on the progress of their mission. Their target was to catch the "{{an|Necrozma|Blinding One}}".

In ''[[SM088|Full Moon and Many Arms!]]'', they were approaching Alola, only to suddenly be left lethargic due to {{an|Necrozma}} draining [[Z-Power|Ultra Aura]] from the adults around the [[region]]. Despite this, they succeeded in catching Necrozma, who had fused with {{an|Lunala}} to take on its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dawn Wings form}}. However, Necrozma quickly broke free of the net. They later launched another attack on Lunala and [[Ash's Solgaleo|Nebby]], but were forced to retreat after being hit by {{m|Flash Cannon}}. They reappeared, no longer feeling lethargic when Necrozma fused with Nebby and fled through an [[Ultra Wormhole]].

In ''[[SM089|The Prism Between Light and Darkness!]]'', they witnessed the [[Ultra Guardians]] following Lunala through an Ultra Wormhole. They attempted to follow, only to be stopped by {{an|Professor Kukui}}, {{an|Faba}}, and their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Having sustained too much damage, it was unsafe for them to proceed through the Ultra Wormhole. Gozu and several Team Rocket Grunts subsequently headed down to [[Ten Carat Hill]] whilst Matori remained on the aircraft to conduct repairs. Gozu easily defeated {{p|Hypno}}, {{p|Alakazam}}, and {{p|Braviary}} with his {{me|Aggron}}, only to be defeated by {{TP|Professor Kukui|Incineroar}} in ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]''. Gozu's group returned to the aircraft when Matori announced the completion of the repairs. They prepared to flying through the Ultra Wormhole, only to be attacked by {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Koko}}, forcing them to retreat.

They reappeared in ''[[SM122|Spying for the Big Guy!]]'', when Matori arrived in Alola to collect {{an|Bewear}} for Giovanni. Realizing that getting Bewear was near impossible, Matori decided to return with {{an|Stufful}} instead, only to be tricked by [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} who disguised Meowth as Stufful. Bewear came to Meowth's rescue, causing the helicopter to crash.

==={{aniseries|JN}}===
In ''[[JN024|A Little Rocket R & R!]]'', [[Matori]] led a group of Grunts to steal Pokémon in the [[Resort Area]]. They initially succeeded, but with Jessie and James's help, {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] managed to get the stolen Pokémon back and force Matori and her Grunts to retreat.

They reappeared in ''[[JN074|Nightfall? Nightmares!]]'' and ''[[JN075|A Midsummer Night's Light!]]'', attempting to capture the [[lunar duo]]. After {{p|Cresselia}} escaped, Matori contacted Jessie, James, and Meowth to assist with Matori planning to blame any failure on their part. After finding Cresselia and {{p|Darkrai}}, Matori led an attack, only for Ash, {{an|Dawn}}, Goh, and [[Chloe]] stopping them before being put to sleep by Darkrai's {{m|Dark Void}}.

{{pkmn|multiverse#In animation|Alternate World}} counterparts of the Matori Matrix members appeared as part of [[Alternate World Team Rocket]] in ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]''. Unlike their counterparts from the main world, they were under the command of Alternate World Jessie, James, and Meowth instead of Matori.

==Trivia==
* Matori Matrix is the first recurring Team Rocket unit in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to feature more than three recurring members.
** It is also the first unit to not be associated with a [[Team Rocket scientist]].
* The {{p|Purugly}}, {{p|Skuntank}}, and {{p|Toxicroak}} prominently used by the Matori Matrix Grunts mimic the signature Pokémon of [[Team Galactic]] {{tc|Commander}}s [[Mars]], [[Jupiter]], and [[Saturn]].
